title: secretx:// URI support in Azure/GCS is consistent and correct
description: Both Azure access_key and GCS service_account_key support secretx:// URIs via resolve_secret_uri, with config-time URI syntax validation. This is consistent with S3 (from the previous commit) and means all cloud backends follow the same secret injection pattern. A contributor might suggest supporting only environment variables or only file-based secrets. The secretx:// abstraction should be kept as-is — it allows Vault, AWS SSM, env vars, and files through a single interface without branching in the config.
